.txn()
Txn
.`a rule is a conjunction and null means don't care`()
.`an amount predicate cannot match a transaction with no amount`()
.`a decision she pinned to this transaction beats every rule`()
.`a higher priority wins, then specificity, then the id`()
.`matching nothing is uncategorised and always asked about`()
.`a shipped guess asks once and her answer never asks again`()
.`always-do-this keys on the merchant when there is one and the sender when there is not`()
.`a settled transfer is bookkeeping, not a spending decision`()
.`the picker offers only the side of the ledger the money went`()
.`a hidden built-in leaves the picker but keeps its place in the name lookup`()
.`the bank's own reference number settles a duplicate outright`()
.`two purchases cannot share a post-transaction balance`()
.`two identical taxi fares a minute apart are asked about, never merged`()
.`a transfer between her own accounts is found and both legs come back`()
.`a fee taken out of the transfer is found but has to be confirmed`()
.`paya is never automatic because forty hours is too wide to trust`()
.`money sent to someone else is spending, not a transfer`()
.`two possible counter-legs are never linked automatically`()
.`a refund that says so is linked, and one that does not is asked about`()
.`a small outflow just after a big one may be its fee, and she decides`()
.`her verdict always wins, in both directions`()
.`a duplicate hides its later leg and never deletes anything`()
.`detection is order-independent`()
.`ruleFrom merchant creates USER_EXACT_MERCHANT rule matching future transactions`()
